countingRules: Trial and survey captures are excluded — only sessions committed for the archive count.
A position photographed twice is one position. Retakes never inflate a count.
An empty page is counted as a page. It was traversed, photographed and recorded as empty.
A page nobody has looked at is "unobserved", never "empty" — those are different claims.
A stamp is counted when a person counts it on a photographed page — confirmed by a human, not a machine.

metrics.unit: positions encountered while traversing an album — pages, covers, inserts, dividers
positions observed to hold philatelic material
albums whose structure a human has classified
stamps a person counted on a photographed page
individual items the binder has bound to a page — one stamp, cover, block or sheet
issuers whose name is printed on a stamp here — as read, not yet resolved to entities
themes the machine grouped read subjects under — candidate, not yet confirmed
territories an issuer here sits in — resolved from the as-read name, candidate not confirmed
issuers here that no longer issue — Ceylon, Umm al-Quwain, the Trucial States; candidate, not confirmed
